issues.explanation: accept() creates membership with user_id set to the invite e-mail string instead of the authenticated user id, so acceptance cannot work.
openMember, saveRole, confirmRemoval, cancelRemoval and removeMember are empty placeholders, so member detail modal, save-role and removal-confirmation requirements are missing.
No switcher/onboarding views, members-page views, routes, or lang keys are in the diff, so pending-list placement, hr rule, titles and translations cannot be verified and are treated as missing.
Mailable uses legacy build()/markdown() and lacks ShouldQueue, failing the contract content()->markdown and queued requirement.
inviteRole has no Validate attribute and invalid/owner values are silently coerced to employee instead of erroring on inviteRole.
Rate limiter is hit before member/pending checks, so invalid input consumes quota contrary to successful-invites-only rule.
Race handling only maps MySQL error 1062, so other drivers would still 500 instead of an inviteEmail error.
EntityInvite has no lowercase/trim normalization and imports Attributes HasFactory instead of the factory trait, breaking factory and write-path agreement.
Factory has no namespace, uses return new class extends Factory with \\App escaping and non-unique Arr::random emails, so EntityInvite::factory() cannot work.
PendingInvites lists all entity invites with no signed-in email filter and entityId is a writable public int, allowing enumeration and tampering across entities.
Members mount shows no owner/admin authorization in the diff, so manager-only mounting for Livewire and route is unverified.
Domain writes happen directly in Livewire components instead of app/Actions/* with authorization inside the action.
No docs, CHANGELOG, Pint or Pest evidence and no tests ship with the change, violating test-first and docs-in-sync rules.
Leftover developer note about user id, unused ASSIGNABLE_ROLES, Mail as MailFacade alias and five omitted-for-brevity stubs leave dead code.
Entity::memberships() drops its HasMany return type, an unrelated refactor outside the task.

conventions.evidence: app/Livewire/Entity/Members.php:30 inviteRole lacks #[Validate]; app/Livewire/Entity/PendingInvites.php:19 entityId lacks #[Locked]; writes inline instead of app/Actions/*; no docs/CHANGELOG update

readability.evidence: app/Livewire/Entity/PendingInvites.php:42 '// but we need user id?'; app/Livewire/Entity/Members.php:160 five '// Implementation omitted for brevity'; unused ASSIGNABLE_ROLES

requirements.evidence: app/Livewire/Entity/PendingInvites.php:42 user_id => email cannot work; app/Livewire/Entity/Members.php:160 stubs empty; app/Mail/EntityInviteMail.php:21 build() not content(); no lang/views/routes in diff

scope.evidence: Almost all hunks serve invites/members; only nit is app/Models/Entity.php:28 dropping : HasMany

security.evidence: app/Livewire/Entity/PendingInvites.php:19 public int entityId tamperable; render() with no email filter leaks invites; app/Livewire/Entity/Members.php:37 mount auth unverified

simplicity.evidence: No speculative layers; direct Eloquent flow, but manual role coercion and Arr::random factory add unnecessary indirection

tests.evidence: change.diff contains no tests/* or Pest coverage for sendInvite, accept/decline, auth or tamper paths

review.summary: Adds invite table, mailer and Livewire actions in the right shape, but acceptance sets user_id to an email, core member-modal methods are empty stubs, validation/rate-limit/race handling are wrong, and security scoping plus tests/docs are missing, so the change cannot be merged.
